title: Finance Analysis Pro Result
description: Canonical machine-readable result for the finance-pro-playbooks framework and its corporate-finance plugin.

skill_financial_transaction_possible.description: Whether this SKILL can place, modify, cancel, sign, broadcast, submit, or otherwise execute a real financial transaction. This field is always false and does not restrict a user's independent activity outside the SKILL.

governance_tier.description: Input-side governance tier from module-catalog.json governance_tier rules. light: no professional editable artifacts (xlsx/docx/pptx) and no external side effects allowed; full: complete governance. Omitted means full.

manual_execution_notice.const: The SKILL did not and cannot perform this financial transaction. This capability limit applies only to the SKILL and the tools or agents operating within it; it does not restrict the user's independent activity outside the SKILL. If the user chooses to transact, they may do so independently on the relevant platform.

materials_review.description: Optional evidence-processing payload for existing-material tasks (deal-screening-scorecard, pre-ic-consistency-review, meeting-minutes), migrated from schema 1.0 irPayload.
